description_en: Retrieves sending data based on specified conditions
description_zh: 获取指定条件下的发送数据
name: SenderStatisticsByTagNameAndBatchID

parameters.help_en: The sender address. If this parameter is not specified, data for all addresses is returned
parameters.help_zh: 发信地址。不填，代表所有地址
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The start time. The time cannot be earlier than 90 days ago. Format: yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间，时间不能早于90日，格式yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The time span between the start time and end time cannot exceed 31 days. Format: yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，和起始时间跨度不能超出31天，格式yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The email tag. If this parameter is not specified, data for all tags is returned
parameters.help_zh: 邮件标签。不填，代表所有标签
parameters.name: tag_name

parameters.help_en:
For dedicated IP users, specifies the ID of a dedicated IP pool to query data for.

If this parameter is not specified, data for all dedicated IP pools is returned
parameters.help_zh:
对于独立IP用户，查询特定的独立IP池ID的数据

不填写此参数时默认查询所有数据
parameters.name: dedicated_ip_pool_id

parameters.help_en:
For dedicated IP users, specifies a dedicated IP address to query data for.

If this parameter is not specified, data for all dedicated IP addresses is returned
parameters.help_zh:
对于独立IP用户，查询特定的独立IP的数据。

不填写此参数时默认查询所有数据
parameters.name: dedicated_ip

parameters.help_en:
For dedicated IP users, specifies a particular ESP to query data for. Valid values:
gmail.com
yahoo.com
outlook.com
icloud.com
others: data for ESPs other than the ones listed above.

If this parameter is not specified, data for all ESPs is returned
parameters.help_zh:
对于独立IP用户，查询特定的ESP数据的数据，可以填写的值如下
gmail.com
yahoo.com
outlook.com
icloud.com
others（对应其他的非上述ESP的数据）

不填写此参数时默认查询所有数据
parameters.name: esp
